main_text.head: I. Theologia Grammaticè deducitur à voce paronymâ Theologus.
main_text.p: Ista, aliaque vocabula similia, Gentilibus olim usurpata, Doctores Christiani jure in usum suum traduxerunt; rei significatæ veri ac justi, Deo dante, posseffores. Hùc pertinet Inscriptio; Ἀποκάλυψις Ἰωάννου Θεολόγου: quoniam ipse Apostolus de Deo accuratissimè disseruit; ὡς Θεότητος καὶ Λόγου, contra Ebionem, Cerinthum, eorumque sequaces singulari zelo asseruit.

page.notes: The woodcut initial "I" is decorative; the Greek is transcribed as far as legible. Several words in the first paragraph are blurred and approximate (e.g. "Statutionis" likely "Substitutionis", "Socinians" likely "Socinianí"). Printed numbers are copied as they appear.
